baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain يَغْفِرَ ... مَا تَقَدَّمَ ... وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ ... وَيُتِمَّ ... وَيَهْدِيَكَ spans pardon, completion, and direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The earlier/later pair totalizes a temporal liability. Protection from its effects clears the addressed person for a favor brought to completion and for gentle direction onto an upright course, so the three promises operate as one repair sequence.

activation_trace.role: Covering an offense while protecting its bearer from the effect supplies the sequence's initial repair operation.
Advance and precedence mark the already-forward temporal side of the liability.
Offense and culpability keep the temporal totalization anchored in moral liability.
Deferral to a later time supplies the not-yet-forward side of the pair.
Bringing a deficient thing to its limit turns pardon into the enabling stage of completion.
Beneficent good condition names what is completed upon the addressee.
Gentle indication toward a way makes guidance the directed outcome of repair and completion.
The straight road gives the completed sequence a traversable spatial form.
Uprightness and equilibrium specify the road's maintained condition rather than merely its destination.

changed_reading.before: Three adjacent promises: pardon, added favor, and guidance.
changed_reading.after: A temporal-total repair: protection from the effects of the whole earlier-and-later liability clears the person for completed beneficence and sustained upright movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَقَدَّمَ, ذَنۢبِكَ, تَأَخَّرَ, صِرَاطًا, and مُّسْتَقِيمًا can form one front-to-rear path image without displacing the moral reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be spatialized as a moving trajectory: a front or advance, a tail or wake, and a rear. Forgiveness covers the route's full extent, while guidance aligns the continuing course. This coexists with, rather than replaces, the temporal-offense baseline.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover supplies an envelope over the trajectory rather than a point cancellation.
The front or leading part furnishes the trajectory's forward edge.
The tail and last part turn liability into the wake left behind an advance.
The rear or back completes the front-tail-rear geometry.
A straight road converts the geometry into a continuing course.
Upright balance supplies the course's corrected alignment.

changed_reading.before: Earlier and later are only dates assigned to sins.
changed_reading.after: They also sketch the leading edge and trailing wake of a life-course whose liabilities are covered from front to rear and whose next movement is aligned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding manifest opening activates a cover/exposure reversal. The public event does not expose the addressee's liability; read through judicial opening and disclosure, it becomes the means by which that liability is visibly settled and its bearer protected.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering of an offense is the focus operation paradoxically produced by an opening.
Opening a closure by judgment or decision supplies a public settlement mechanism.
Manifest disclosure makes the settlement visible, sharpening the paradox that disclosure can protect.

structural_cues: 48:1 immediately precedes 48:2, and the purpose lām in لِّيَغْفِرَ grammatically links the opening to the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judicial opening and manifest disclosure; I infer that the public opening settles rather than exposes the temporal liability. A live alternative is that the lām marks purpose while pardon remains mechanistically independent of the opening.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is a private covering unrelated to public change.
changed_reading.after: A manifest public opening can itself function as clearance: what is opened in history closes the liability's power over the addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The descent of settledness into hearts so that faith increases with faith turns completion from a single terminal grant into staged internal consolidation. Completed favor and guidance can therefore name a process in which agitation ceases, an inner center stabilizes, and capacity grows.

activation_trace.role: Attaining completion supplies the endpoint of the staged consolidation.
Beneficent good condition is recast as a capacity that can deepen over time.
A place of settled stability supplies the inner base from which completion can proceed.
The core or innermost part locates the consolidation beneath outward success.
Increase and growth provide the incremental motion toward completed favor.

structural_cues: 48:4 gives an explicit descent-to-heart-to-increase sequence rather than an instantaneous state change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies settling, inward location, and increase; I infer that these are intermediate stages of the focus's completed favor. The alternative is that 48:4 describes the believers collectively and should not determine the singular addressee's process.

changed_reading.before: Completion adds a finished external favor after pardon.
changed_reading.after: Completion is also an inwardly staged stabilization: settledness creates a base, and increase accumulates until favor becomes durable capacity for guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene of those left in the rear who seek to follow, coupled with a reference to what was before, socializes the focus's front-tail-rear geometry. The addressed person's dhanb can be heard not only as an offense but as a consequential wake containing followers, claimants, and laggards affected by the route already taken.

activation_trace.role: Advance and precedence provide the moving front of a social procession.
Followers and social tails make the singular liability radiate into a wake of attached persons and consequences.
The rear gives that attached wake a definite processional position.
People remaining in the rear instantiate the otherwise latent social back of the route.
Following in another's track supplies the relation binding rearward people to the advance.
Precedence and approach reactivate the focus's forward temporal-spatial pole.

structural_cues: 48:15 places rearward people, attempted following, and a reference to what came before inside one movement scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a social front and rear; I infer that the focus's singular account includes responsibility for a trailing wake. The strong alternative remains the direct reading of ذنب as personal wrongdoing with no collective extension.

changed_reading.before: The paired liability is private and bounded by the individual's acts.
changed_reading.after: It may also include the wake of an advance: delayed followers, attached claims, and downstream effects that need covering before the route can be aligned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct repetition of guidance to a straight path after hands are restrained, followed by the detained h-d-y offering and the danger of unknowingly trampling hidden people and acquiring a stain, turns guidance into an engineered corridor of restraint. Deferral prevents a new trailing liability; forgiveness is thus paired with not generating the aftereffect that would later require covering.

activation_trace.role: Protection from an offense's effect supplies the focus-side result that restraint prospectively preserves.
The tail or aftermath lets unseen collateral harm count as a trailing liability.
Withholding and prevention make non-action the operative means of opening a clean route.
Gentle direction explicitly follows restraint, linking prevented force to guidance.
The repeated straight road names the corridor produced by restraint.
The offering directed toward the sanctuary materializes guidance as something delayed yet still destination-bound.
Detention and prevention supply the temporary stop that protects the route from premature completion.
Severe pressure underfoot makes the otherwise hidden collateral mechanism concrete.
A stain of evil names the liability that would attach after unknowing harm.

structural_cues: 48:20 places the repeated وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا immediately after the restraint of hands.
48:25 conditionally links a detained h-d-y offering, unknown protected persons, trampling, and acquisition of a maʿarra.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, a repeated straight path, delayed destination, hidden persons, and prospective stain; I infer the arrow restraint prevents future aftermath and is itself a mode of guidance. The live alternative is that these are local tactical and ritual details rather than a general account of the focus sequence.

changed_reading.before: Guidance identifies the correct direction after earlier and later faults are pardoned.
changed_reading.after: Guidance also builds a clean passage by withholding premature force; the delayed step protects unseen lives and prevents a new stain from joining the route's trailing liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: An 'other' objective beyond present ability is nevertheless enclosed and preserved, while the truthful promised entry is routed through a nearer opening short of the ultimate goal. This activates تَأَخَّرَ as a held-back segment of fulfillment whose trailing liabilities are already covered, not only as later wrongdoing.

activation_trace.role: Tail and aftermath permit the focus liability to extend into consequences of a delayed phase.
Another thing after the first supplies a concrete later segment rather than an abstract future.
Present inability to effect or possess the objective explains why its realization is delayed.
Protective enclosure makes delay a form of preservation rather than abandonment.
Fulfillment of a promise guarantees the destination despite intermediate delay.
Entry into an interior supplies the promised endpoint toward which the held segment moves.
Nearness short of the goal defines the interim opening as a real advance without final arrival.
Proximity makes the interim stage part of fulfillment rather than evidence of failure.

structural_cues: 48:21 pairs an 'other' objective with present inability and divine enclosure.
48:27 affirms the promised entry while placing a near opening before it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preserved later objective and an interim opening; I infer that the focus's delayed side can include liabilities and aftereffects of a held phase. The grammatical alternative remains straightforward later sin, since مِن ذَنبِكَ governs both temporal members.

changed_reading.before: مَا تَأَخَّرَ points only to offenses located in the future.
changed_reading.after: It can additionally activate the protected tail of an unfinished mission: a later segment held beyond present ability whose risks are covered while fulfillment approaches by stages.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final plant sequence supplies an organic mechanism for completion: an offshoot emerges, is supported, thickens after thinness, attains its own completeness, and stands on a load-bearing stalk. The focus's completed favor and upright course can therefore describe emergent capacity produced through mutual support, with forgiveness named again after the growth image.

activation_trace.role: Attaining a thing's full limit is re-rendered as maturation rather than instant addition.
Beneficent good condition becomes the living capacity developed by the growth sequence.
Upright balance supplies the focus endpoint echoed by the plant's self-support.
Cultivation and growth establish the organic domain of the mechanism.
An offshoot emerging around the original shows completion beginning as dependent new growth.
Plants strengthening one another supplies mutual support as the causal bridge to maturity.
Thickening after thinness marks acquired resilience rather than original force.
Completion and straightness in the thing itself align maturation with the focus's uprightness.
The load-bearing stalk supplies the material support on which achieved uprightness stands.
The renewed promise of protective forgiveness binds the growth image back to the focus's opening operation.

structural_cues: 48:29 chains emergence, support, thickening, self-completion, and standing on stalks before repeating the promise of forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered plant mechanics and renewed forgiveness; I infer that this sequence models how the focus's favor reaches completion and uprightness. The live alternative is that the simile characterizes the community only and should not be transferred to the singular focus addressee.

changed_reading.before: Completed favor is a finished benefit conferred from outside.
changed_reading.after: Completed favor can be living capacity: dependent growth is supported, thickens, becomes internally sound, and finally bears itself upright.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping of ه د ي to the image of lulling a child, not the ordinary guidance inventory. It remains anchored in يَهْدِيَكَ and is activated by the later descent of settledness; downstream prose should mark it as an affective-motion analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the focus verb.

activation_trace.role: Rhythmic lulling until a child settles supplies an exploratory mode by which guidance quiets unstable motion.
Cessation of motion activates the calming rather than directional aspect of the split guidance image.
Upright equilibrium provides the stable state reached after agitation is quieted.

changed_reading.before: Guidance communicates or indicates the correct route.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance may also calm oscillation until the addressed person can hold an upright course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material reading is branch-distant because it combines generic covering, a piece that completes weaving, and softness rather than the direct pardon and beneficence senses. It remains focus-only and tightly anchored in the sequence يَغْفِرَ ... وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ; downstream prose should present it only as a tactile model of how the abstract operations cohere.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَغْفِرَ, يُتِمَّ, نِعْمَتَهُ, and عَلَيْكَ in 48:2.

activation_trace.role: A preserving cover supplies the protective material of the model.
A piece supplied to finish a weave makes completion the closure of a protective gap.
Softness and ease give the completed covering the felt quality of beneficence.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and completed favor are separate abstract benefits.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, completion supplies the missing piece of a soft protective covering laid upon the addressee.

strongest_changes: The opening-covering opposition became a public-clearance mechanism: manifest opening can settle rather than expose liability.
Repeated restraint of hands and the prevention of unknowing trampling changed the straight path into a protected corridor that avoids creating a future stain.
The final plant chain changed completed favor from a static grant into supported growth that thickens and becomes self-upright.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept several non-equivalent mechanisms alive: moral temporal repair, a front-to-rear wake, inward consolidation, protective deferral, staged fulfillment, and organic maturation. The split ه د ي mapping and the weaving branches also produced contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar of مِن ذَنبِكَ keeps personal moral liability stronger than the social-tail and delayed-mission readings.
The purpose lām links 48:1 and 48:2, but it does not by itself prove that public opening is the causal mechanism of forgiveness.
The plant process directly describes a community, so its transfer to the singular addressee remains analogical.
The calming and woven-protection outliers depend on branch-distant images and require explicit exploratory qualification.
